content: gakonst.com (Georgios Konstantopoulos, Paradigx CTO) is a strong real example of a senior crypto engineer's minimalist personal site: name + 1-line roles (CTO/GP at Paradigm, CEO at Ithaca), credibility via association with known orgs, list of OSS projects (Reth, Foundry, Alloy) as proof of work, About/Contact pages, and a personal-interest section (DJing) that humanizes without diluting credibility. No heavy visuals, no gradients -- text and whitespace only.
